<function=python>
<parameter=code>
res=action(['DOWN','DOWN','DOWN'])
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
S=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(a) for j,ch in enumerate(row) if ch=='S']
rows=sorted(set(i for i,j in S)); cols=sorted(set(j for i,j in S))
print("S rows",min(rows),max(rows),"cols",min(cols),max(cols))
# cluster into two eyes by col
L=[(i,j) for i,j in S if j<31]; R=[(i,j) for i,j in S if j>=31]
print("L eye r",min(i for i,j in L),max(i for i,j in L),"c",min(j for i,j in L),max(j for i,j in L))
print("R eye r",min(i for i,j in R),max(i for i,j in R),"c",min(j for i,j in R),max(j for i,j in R))
print("level_completed:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
# what color is under where L eye now is?
lr0=min(i for i,j in L); lc0=min(j for i,j in L)
print("L eye region colors:",set(a[lr0][lc0:lc0+5]))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

print("R eye r",min(i for i,j in R),max(i for i,j in R),"c",min(j for i,j in R),max(j for i,j in R))
print("level_completed:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
# what color is under where L eye now is?
lr0=min(i for i,j in L); lc0=min(j for i,j in L)
print("L eye region colors:",set(a[lr0][lc0:lc0+5]))
